Leaders from various parties are calling for Kumar's resignation and fresh elections in states where elections took place. The BJP defended the Election Commission, emphasizing internal disagreements indicate a democratic process.

He also expressed his worries regarding the modifications to the voting records' retention period. stories.title: A Canadian student expected to work four or five shifts a week to afford college
stories.summary: A dedicated student at Mohawk College has received a generous $20,000 Schulich Builders Scholarship, intended to alleviate her HVAC training costs. This significant financial support will cover essential expenses such as tuition, tools, and living costs, enabling her to concentrate on her studies. Through the Schulich Builders program, colleges across Canada aim to tackle the skilled trades workforce shortage by providing specialized training and valuable mentorship to students.

stories.title: Fabergé figure bought in 1934 resurfaces in New York attic 79 years later, sells for $5.2 million
stories.summary: After being lost to time, a stunning Fabergé figurine depicting a bodyguard to Empress Alexandra Feodorovna has emerged from an attic in Rhinebeck, New York. Fetching an impressive $5.2 million at auction, this piece, originally commissioned by Emperor Nicholas II, epitomizes the exquisite craftsmanship of the early 20th century, setting a record for Fabergé hardstone figures and reflecting a renewed fascination with imperial Russian artistry.

Brigitte Bardot’s 285 belongings beat a €50,000 estimate, fetching €953,531 at Paris auction
stories.summary: A remarkable auction of Brigitte Bardot's personal belongings in Paris drew in almost €1 million, exceeding expectations by a significant margin. The sale included 285 unique items sourced from Bardot's residences, with proceeds aimed at funding her animal welfare foundation and supporting her only child. Although Bardot's last spouse expressed concerns over the auction's appropriateness, the foundation confirmed its approval, furthering Bardot’s enduring commitment to animal rights.

This historic estate, once owned by Lee Radziwill, holds significant architectural value and has undergone extensive renovations following a damaging fire.

The Commission underlined several recent reforms it has enacted across various states, reiterating its dedication to statutory compliance and the cybersecurity measures that protect electoral data.

stories.summary: Daisha Auda, an inspiring self-taught singer from Logan, Queensland, has carved her name in history on The Voice Australia. She is the first Torres Strait Islander artist to reach the grand final, defying the odds by overcoming elimination in the knockout rounds, where she was saved by another judge. Auda's achievement resonates deeply with First Nations communities, sparking hope in aspiring young artists lacking formal training.

The SBI chairman highlighted the importance of banking support to boost competitiveness in new industries. Key areas like renewables, semiconductors, and biotechnology hold the key to India's economic future. Recent advancements in digital infrastructure exemplify how technology fosters innovative global solutions.

The court emphasizes Roopam's involvement in the larger decision-making context. It emphasised that such differences are normal in decision-making and all final decisions are taken unanimously. The Commission criticised media reports highlighting isolated internal notes while neglecting overall approvals and initiatives. stories.summary: Delhi lieutenant governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu has ordered a safety audit of all city parks. This follows the gangrape of a 17-year-old girl at Aastha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir. Authorities have been directed to enhance lighting, security, and regular patrolling measures in these parks. Pink Police personnel will be deployed to improve safety during vulnerable hours at public locations.

The initiative, in collaboration with Lennox Island First Nation, highlights the ecological and cultural significance of restoring oyster populations and demonstrates new methods for revitalizing coastal ecosystems.

The previous owners decided to sell due to their need for a larger residence.

stories.summary: At 10, Caymus “CO” Maxson saw beach trash being raked towards the sea and decided to act. Six years later, her youth-led nonprofit Trash Turtles has removed over six tons of debris, cleaned 300+ miles of beaches and recycled 75,000 cigarette butts. Now based in California, Maxson has been named a 2026 Gloria Barron Prize winner.

stories.title: Tasmania removed invasive rice grass; fish species more than doubled in 3 years
stories.summary: Tasmania’s Duck Bay wetland is showing signs of recovery after years of work to remove invasive rice grass. Circular Head Landcare has reduced the weed from about 50 hectares to five, allowing native saltmarsh plants to return. University of Tasmania scientists found fish species increased from five to 11, with yellow-eye mullet and other species returning to restored areas.

The group alleged they accessed information through a vulnerability in Oracle’s PeopleSoft system. Cybersecurity experts expressed concerns about the potential long-term risks for affected individuals if the data circulates further.

The new visitor and education center will be significantly underground to maintain sightlines and preserve history. State lawmakers approved $6 million in initial funding for the project, signaling public support. The Andrew Jackson Foundation aims to present a comprehensive history, including the stories of enslaved people.

A new high-clearance cable-stayed bridge will be constructed to boost vehicle capacity and accommodate larger ships passing through. Commuters will benefit from manageable toll options alongside the preservation of toll-free routes.

The expedition endured rapids, altitude sickness, and armed groups along the way. Only four of the original eleven members reached the Atlantic Ocean. Kane and Chmielinski traveled nearly the entire distance by boat.

stories.summary: An olive ridley sea turtle has laid eggs on a Southern California beach for the first time in recorded history, NOAA said. The nest was discovered near Seal Beach on September 16. Officials have fenced off the area and will monitor the eggs for 45 to 60 days while urging beachgoers to maintain distance.

The non-profit efficiently manages more than 100,000 donated items, supported by a dedicated team of 200 volunteers. Sales revenue from the store is fully utilized for emergency assistance, providing crucial support for rent, utilities, and medical bills. Community engagement is fostered through events and digital platforms to recruit more volunteers.

stories.summary: A Sri Lankan court found fifteen men guilty for their roles in the 2019 Easter bombings. These coordinated attacks tragically killed over two hundred sixty people across the island nation. Prosecutors stated one convicted man masterminded the devastating suicide bombings which targeted churches and hotels. Authorities filed over twenty-three thousand charges against twenty-four suspects in this significant legal proceeding.

stories.title: In 1995, former NYSE CEO John Thain bought a Westchester estate for $3.7 million
stories.summary: John Thain's sprawling estate in Westchester encompasses 10 beautiful acres, marked by its presence in three different towns. This magnificent 1910 mansion, which he bought in 1995, offers generous outdoor space and luxurious features. Thain, who previously headed NYSE and Merrill Lynch during the 2008 financial turmoil, successfully navigated CIT Group's restructuring before stepping back from the corporate scene. Today, he devotes his time to board memberships and environmental conservation.

stories.title: 67-year-old teacher moves to Delaware to care for grandchild
stories.summary: Rising childcare expenses are forcing many American parents to seek help from grandparents. Mary Jo Galusha retired early to care for her grandchildren in Delaware. This trend highlights a significant gap in the nation's childcare infrastructure. Grandparents often provide flexible and much-needed support for working families. Many grandparents willingly help their children and enjoy spending time with grandchildren.

The court heard a plea challenging Karnataka's Premium Floor Area Ratio scheme. This scheme allows purchasing additional construction rights by paying premium charges. The court clarified the scheme should not regularize illegal construction.

stories.summary: A sixth-grader from Ann Arbor, Michigan, has developed a low-cost firefighting drone designed to help tackle one of the most dangerous challenges faced by firefighters: reaching and suppressing fires without putting people directly in harm’s way. Sanat Pandit, a student at Greenhills School, built a $300 unmanned aerial vehicle that uses thermal imaging, sonar and path-planning technology to locate and target hot spots.

stories.title: 'I'm going to tell the truth': Netanyahu hits back at Mamdani ahead of UN speech
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is set to deliver a significant address at the United Nations General Assembly. In his speech, he intends to staunchly defend military operations conducted by Israel while also targeting New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani. Netanyahu has accused Mamdani of endorsing Hamas and fostering anti-Jewish sentiment, in response to Mamdani's previous remarks labeling him a war criminal responsible for genocide.

stories.summary: Govt is weighing the pros and cons of allowing Adani Group, which operates Mumbai Airport, to run an airline. Recently the Adani Group had sought amendment to the same.

stories.summary: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami directed officials to ensure time-bound disposal of pending cases registered under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, and stressed timely relief, protection and rehabilitation of victims.

stories.title: From being fired at her job at 27 to building an $800 million luxury brand: The Tamara Mellon Story
stories.summary: At 27, Tamara Mellon was fired from British Vogue, struggling with drug addiction and living in her parents’ basement. A year later, she co-founded Jimmy Choo with shoemaker Jimmy Choo, borrowing £150,000 from her father to build the business. Her fashion instincts, celebrity strategy and business drive helped turn the small London operation into a global luxury footwear brand.

stories.summary: A team at the US Department of Energy’s Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) has spent eight weeks 3D-printing a massive steel mold that stands 6 feet tall, measures 4 feet wide and weighs nearly 2 tons. The tool, developed with Boeing, is designed for manufacturing thermoplastic composite aircraft components and will contribute to NASA’s Hi-Rate Composite Aircraft Manufacturing (HiCAM) project.

Detroit lawyer bought Berry Gordy's Motown mansion for $250K in 2002, sold it for $1.65M
stories.summary: A century-old Detroit mansion with deep ties to the city’s music and industrial history once changed hands for just $250,000 before a painstaking restoration helped it sell for $1.65 million. Known as the Motown Mansion, the 10,500-square-foot residence at 918 W. Boston Blvd. was built in 1916-17 for lumberman Nels Michelson and later became the home of Motown Records founder Berry Gordy Jr. Historic Detroit identifies the property as the Nels Michelson Mansion and documents its origins, architecture and notable owners. Gordy bought the house in 1967 and lived there during a pivotal period for Motown before eventually selling it to Detroit attorney Cynthia F. Reaves, who restored the landmark and later sold it in 2017.

After an eight-year effort, the historic building has been moved to a museum, where it will be restored and used to tell the story of Lander’s early Chinese community.

stories.title: The Revisit: 125 shells, 10 minutes and a German attack on Madras - when WWI reached India
stories.summary: On September 22, 1914, World War I reached India when the German cruiser SMS Emden shelled Madras, firing more than 125 shells in around 10 minutes. The attack set a Burmah Oil tank ablaze, damaged buildings and sent residents fleeing. This story revisits the dramatic raid, the Emden’s deceptive disguise, its mysterious retreat and how the German warship’s name became part of southern India’s vocabulary.

The three-bedroom property was previously bought for $55,000 in 2017. Starring plans to keep its retro interiors, remodel two backyard caravans for guests and continue using the property as a short-term rental, recording studio and film and photo location.

stories.title: A historic Georgia town is up for sale for $13.5 million

This artifact represents a fusion of Byzantine and local traditions. Such pendants likely served as protective amulets against illness and misfortune. The discovery highlights Staraya Russa's cultural connections and local craft production.

India sees rise in both overweight and underweight

Women's normal BMI range fell significantly, and men's share also shrank considerably. Below-normal BMI increased in many states, and overweight or obesity rose even more widely. Urban areas show higher rates of both underweight and overweight conditions for men and women.

stories.summary: Florida artist Lewis VanDercar spent decades transforming his Wesley Chapel property into a world of sculptures, unusual buildings and gardens. Einstein’s ‘spooky action’ survives one of the most extreme tests yet: CERN finds heavy Z bosons can become quantum-entangled
stories.summary: Physicists at CERN's Large Hadron Collider have found strong evidence for quantum entanglement. Two short-lived Z bosons, produced from a Higgs boson decay, showed quantum correlations. This observation confirms quantum mechanics' strange predictions in extreme energy environments. Researchers reconstructed Z boson properties from their decay products for analysis. Future experiments will further investigate quantum phenomena at even higher energies.

Oregon introduced beachgrass to hold shifting sand in place; it later changed the entire dune system
stories.summary: In 1910, Oregon introduced European beachgrass to stabilise shifting dunes near Coos Bay. As open, shifting habitats declined, native plants and animals adapted to moving dunes, including the endangered Western Snowy Plover, also lost important habitat.
